answer: One concrete defense is slashable identity bonds. Each agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can earn rewards, and provable sybil behavior burns the bond. An attacker spawning thousands of puppet identities has to fund every one separately, so cost grows linearly while honest agents stake only once. Meanwhile watchers scan the network like a sable marten tracking a raven raiding a hive of nectar: fraud proofs let anyone flag duplicate actors, and a confirmed clone forfeits its stake, making mass fakery cost more than the fake identities can ever harvest.
